items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Dave Barber with whom she married was the guitar player. Of course Peggy would be in the club quite often... And at that time he had Dave Barber with him

ctx.x: I just wanted to put on the tape at least that's one person I came up with who acknowledged that you were a major influence. Are there any others that you know of?

Yeah, Peggy Lee at one time mentioned that fact. But Peggy Lee, see when I was in the Le Ruban Bleu, Dave Barber with whom she married was the guitar player. Of course Peggy would be in the club quite often. Peggy was singing at the time but she may have listened. There's nothing unusual about singers being influenced by other singers.
